properties.description:
#DONT_CORR#
This rule triggers when a log stoppage of a high criticality table is observed, for this rule to work as expected the table and severity must be inside 
the "TableOfflineIndex" watchlist. For this analytic "log stoppage" is classified as such as when the table in question does not ingest data for over an hour.
Time thresholds are defined as follows and should be customized based on the specific needs and use case of the environment,
"High" - 1 Hour, "Moderate" - 3 hours, "Medium" - 6 Hours, "Low" - 12 Hours, "VeryLow" - 24 Hours, "Lowest" - 72 Hours, "Weekly" - 7 days.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Override}} - Please check the source of the logs in your environment. If this is not planned maintenance or expected gap, please select Actions -> Send to Quorum Cyber to escalate to Quorum Cyber Engineering for investigation.
